visualCharacteristics.purpose: Click-to-play video embed with poster image; supports Vidyard, YouTube and Vimeo

sources.stylingNotes: Embedded Vidyard video player ("Broken Arm" spot) with poster thumbnail.

contentPattern.structure: one cell: optional poster image, then the video link (https://play.vidyard.com/<id>, YouTube or Vimeo URL)
contentPattern.description: Single embedded Vidyard video (https://play.vidyard.com/n6HxhPYUCyuv9VgKD4YcuY) with poster image

usage: Single standalone video with a poster image. If no poster is authored, the Vidyard/YouTube thumbnail is used; otherwise the iframe lazy-loads when scrolled into view.
reuseGuidance: Use for any single hosted video. Use the base embed block for social posts (Twitter) or non-video iframes.
